atom.description: Buttons, icon links, and tap targets sized below the WCAG 2.2 AA minimum of 24×24 CSS pixels — typically 16×16 or 20×20 icon-only buttons. On mobile devices, users tap the wrong target, hit two adjacent items at once, or fail to register the tap entirely. The thumb-tip averages ~8mm; targets below 24px require precision the device cannot provide.
